purpose: Provide a generic stable-key anchor adapter while keeping the opening-specific state anchor intact and preventing duplicate apply operations.

authority.opening_boundary: AMelodiaOpeningStateAnchor remains opening-specific and is not the generic adapter
authority.save_write: canonical save contract owned by UMelodiaNarrativeSubsystem

preflight: BP verifies an allowed shared capability-gate result using GateRequestId and EvaluationFingerprint before calling this adapter
validate stable AnchorId, PersistenceKey, and ApplyIntentId
validate every operation against existing narrative allowlists
reject duplicate or partially-applied state before mutation
atomic_mutations: retain PersistenceKey as the stable diagnostic identity
post_commit_events: broadcast changed flags or quest intents
apply_transaction.rollback_rule: if any operation is invalid, change no canonical field
apply_transaction.replay_rule: the same ApplyIntentId returns already_applied and may replay presentation only

allowed: replay presentation after load without reapplying state
forbidden: call SetNarrativeFlag and SetQuestActive as independent unjournaled operations
erase canonical state during fixture reset
use a level-local boolean as the persistent source of truth
create a second save object or opening authority

gate_boundary.bp_obligation: re-evaluate the shared capability gate on enter, context/progression/load/travel/reset changes and forward only an allowed result
gate_boundary.native_obligation: validate canonical IDs and apply atomically; do not claim to re-evaluate an uncompiled gate registry
gate_boundary.promotion_requirement: fresh evidence envelope contains GateRequestId, EvaluationFingerprint, and the matching native apply result

promotion_evidence: invalid operation leaves the record byte-equivalent
first apply commits all operations once
second apply is already_applied with no duplicate quest/flag event
fixture route records the application and replay fingerprints
